```go
func FindMaxFreq(nums []int) int {
    freqMap := make(map[int]int)
	for _, num := range nums {
		if freq, exists := freqMap[num]; exists {
			freqMap[num] = freq + 1
		} else {
			freqMap[num] = 1
		}
	}
	maxFreq := -1
	for num, freq := range freqMap {
		if freq >= num && num > maxFreq {
			maxFreq = num
		}
	}
	return maxFreq
}
```
